autoChange.title: Auto IP change
autoChange.help: Each rule is a chain of stages. A stage fires once: when the chosen hosts' traffic on a node stays under its threshold for its time (usually: the IP got blocked), the hosts move to the stage's IP. Then the next stage starts watching, right away or once the new IP carried some traffic or some time passed. After the last stage the rule stops until you reset it.
autoChange.hostsHelp: Their address is replaced; their inbounds' traffic is what gets measured.
autoChange.nodesHelp: A switch happens when any of these drops under the threshold.
autoChange.requireOnlineHelp: Somebody must be connected somewhere in the panel, so a quiet night isn't taken for a block.
autoChange.noData: No traffic data yet; it builds up over the next minutes.
autoChange.liveHelp: Average of the last 30 s; the timer runs while it stays under {{threshold}} KB/s
autoChange.empty: No rules yet. Add one to watch your hosts.
autoChange.reset: Start over from stage 1 (hosts keep their address)
autoChange.saveToStart: Save the rule to start watching.
autoChange.stagesHelp: Run top to bottom, each one once.
autoChange.startWhenRate: when the new IP carries {{rate}} KB/s
autoChange.finished: All stages are done. The rule won't switch again until you reset it.
autoChange.startsHelp: 0 = off. Both off: starts right after the previous switch.

vpn.title: VPN services
vpn.help: AmneziaWG and OpenVPN on each server, next to Xray. Users get them on their subscription page; traffic counts toward their limit, and expired, limited or disabled users are cut off automatically. Each server needs the Alexen VPN agent.
vpn.installMaster: Run this on the panel server as root (once).
vpn.installNode: Run this on the node ({{address}}) as root. Docker is installed if missing; the first build takes a few minutes.
vpn.installAfter: The panel must reach TCP {{port}} on that server; open the AmneziaWG / OpenVPN ports in its firewall too.
vpn.saved: Saved: the server picks it up within a few seconds
vpn.pinReset: The agent's certificate will be trusted again on the next contact
vpn.randomizeHelp: Users must download the AmneziaWG file again after this
vpn.obfuscationHelp: Jc/Jmin/Jmax: junk packets before the handshake; S1/S2: padding; H1–H4: packet type headers. The same values go into every user's file.
vpn.ovpnHelp: Certificates and the tls-crypt key are made by the panel. Each user has one certificate for all servers and devices.
vpn.publicAddressHelp: What the apps connect to. Must reach this server directly (no CDN proxy: UDP).
vpn.nodeHelp: Port, subnet, obfuscation and the agent install command:
vpn.tcpHint: If a mobile network blocks OpenVPN over UDP (handshake starts, then stops), switch to TCP, ideally on port 443.
groups.vpnHint: Like hosts: a service in a group is only for users of admins limited to that group; one in no group is for everyone.
groups.vpnOff: Turned off on this server (Nodes → VPN services)
vpn.devicesHelp: Each device gets its own file and key, so they can be connected at the same time (1 to {{max}}). OpenVPN needs no setting: one file works on several devices.
